$comment: The acceptance gate fails on any compact-health problem that is NOT listed here.
An entry means: this degradation is known, has an owner record, and must not page.
It does NOT mean the problem is acceptable forever -- expiresAt forces a re-review,
and the gate fails outright once that date passes.
A temporary rollout entry may add an entry-level `expiresAt` bounded to the first
scheduled cron window. At or after that instant, its live problem blocks even when
the root expiresAt is later. A health-probe cutover requires either a completed
Railway-side pre-seed, a one-way durable activation marker, or this owner-bound, expiring acknowledgement.
Entries are matched on name:status exactly. A source that recovers is reported as
'recovered' on the next run (prune it); a source that fails with a DIFFERENT status
than the one baselined is treated as new and blocks, which is the point.
Every entry carries a real tracking issue, never the PR that introduced the entry:
a merged PR closes, and a suppression pointing at a closed PR has no owner.
Softening fault statuses is the marketImplications blind spot the ON_DEMAND_KEYS policy
block in api/health.js exists to prevent.

acknowledged.name: mineralProduction
acknowledged.reason: Re-anchored to seed-bundle-static-ref-heavy's first tick (#6806). The previous acknowledgement expired at 2026-08-18T03:00Z on the very tick that deferred this section by 13 seconds: Arms-Suppliers measured 371s of leftover's 570s budget and Submarine-Cables took 22s more, leaving 177s against a 190s reservation. The concurrency fix (#6807) was not enough because the ordering question survived it. Mineral-Production now sits in a 3-member bundle whose lead slot rotates daily, so it leads every third tick and fits behind either heavy member on the other two (371+190=561s, 335+190=525s). EMPTY after its first scheduled run is a real problem.

acknowledged.name: demographicsCapability
acknowledged.reason: The new demographics capability probe cannot exist until the updated seed-bundle-static-ref image runs its first daily 03:00 UTC tick. EMPTY is acknowledged only through that first scheduled run; after it, fewer than 150 countries or no publication must block acceptance.

acknowledged.name: manitobaRoads
acknowledged.reason: manitobaRoads now probes seed-meta:infra:manitoba-511. MANITOBA_511_KEY is configured on Railway seed-bundle-canada; the seed-meta key still cannot exist until the first eligible Provincial-511 admission after this seeder deploys. The shared runner can skip the 12:05 and 12:10 ticks while Ontario metadata is inside its 0.8-interval freshness window, so EMPTY is acknowledged only through 12:15 and must block immediately afterward.

acknowledged.name: staticRefHeavyBundleTick
acknowledged.reason: New seed-bundle-static-ref-heavy cron (#6806), one service carrying Arms-Suppliers, Military-Bases and Mineral-Production. The heartbeat key does not exist until the Railway service is provisioned and fires `0 4 * * *`. EMPTY before that first scheduled tick is the deploy window, not a frozen scheduler. This entry replaces the two planned 1-section siblings: Railway's service budget is capped at 100 and the fleet is at 81, so three isolated services for three low-cadence members was not a trade worth making when the runner's per-tick deferral already separates them.

acknowledged.name: militaryBasesSeed
acknowledged.reason: New freshness probe for the military-bases corpus (#6845 item 3). seed-meta:military:bases has never been written: the corpus is published (military:bases:active points at version 1786244633231 from 2026-08-09) but the heartbeat is absent, which is exactly the blind spot this probe closes -- the pointer stayed green while the data behind it aged. Military-Bases leads seed-bundle-static-ref-heavy on the next rotation offset-2 tick; STALE_SEED after that run is a real problem.
